title: pandanus tectorius var. oahuensis
intro: Pandanus tectorius var. oahuensis, commonly known as Hawaiian screw pine, is a type of plant native to the Hawaiian Islands. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including wounds, skin irritations, and fever, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pandanus tectorius var. oahuensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and skin-soothing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
